summary: BGIN Blockchain Ltd filed a Form 6-K on June 5, 2026, reporting two changes: (i) the board accepted Pengju Wang's resignation as Co-CFO and approved his appointment as Board Secretary; (ii) the board appointed Weina Wang as Co-CFO, effective immediately. Weina Wang, previously Finance Director, has an MBA from Columbia and experience at Farfetch. The moves are routine succession and role reshuffling, not forced departures. No transaction terms, premiums, or shareholder involvement. This is a corporate governance update, not a special-situation event—classified as Management Changes per filing content. Watch for further officer adjustments.
